title: 7-Day Task Aversion Cure
description: Some tasks feel so unpleasant that avoiding them has become a relief mechanism. This program breaks that pattern.
outcomes: Identify tasks you're avoiding and why

days.title: The Avoidance List
days.insight: What tasks do you consistently avoid? Why? Is it because they're unpleasant, confusing, or meaningless?
days.action: Write down 5 tasks you've been avoiding. For each, write: Why am I avoiding this? What makes it unpleasant?
days.reflectionQuestion: What task am I avoiding and why?

days.title: The Minimum Viable Action
days.insight: You don't need to do the whole task to start. You just need to do the smallest first step.
days.action: Choose one task you're avoiding. What's the smallest first step? Do that one thing. Nothing else.
days.reflectionQuestion: What's the smallest first step for this task?

days.title: The Pairing Trick
days.insight: Pair unpleasant tasks with pleasant activities. Make the work worth the effort.
days.action: Choose one unpleasant task. What can you pair it with? Music? Coffee? A walk afterward?
days.reflectionQuestion: What can I pair with this unpleasant task?

days.title: The 5-Minute Rule
days.insight: You can always stop after 5 minutes. But many times, you'll keep going.
days.action: Set a timer for 5 minutes. Work on the task. When the timer goes off, you can stop. See what happens.
days.reflectionQuestion: What would I do if I only had 5 minutes?

days.title: The Body Double
days.insight: Working with someone else makes unpleasant tasks more bearable. Even if you're not working together.
days.action: Find a quiet place to work with someone else. Even if you're both working separately, your presence helps.
days.reflectionQuestion: Who can I work with today?

days.title: The Progress Loop
days.insight: Done feels better than not done. Action creates momentum.
days.action: Complete one task you've been avoiding. Write it down. Check it off. Feel the relief.

days.title: The Reward System
days.insight: Reward effort, not just results. This builds a new association with unpleasant tasks.
days.action: Choose a reward for completing unpleasant tasks. It can be small — a coffee, 10 minutes of social media.
days.reflectionQuestion: What's a small reward I can give myself for doing unpleasant work?
